body:
Solace plays a sound when an agent finishes, and a different sound when a task needs attention. A new **Notifications** tab on the Settings page turns each one off.

- **Finished:** a work run on a task ends without needing the human.
- **Needs attention:** the cases the board already marks as needing attention: a question, a failed run, or a discussion waiting on the human. Only this sound plays for such a run, not both.
- The sounds play on whichever page is open.
- **Settings → Notifications:** one setting for each sound, both on by default. A change takes effect at once and is kept after a reload.

Out of scope: Strategy and Design page runs, system (desktop) notifications, and choosing volume or the sounds themselves.

**Tests:** each case picks its sound; a turned-off sound doesn't play; the tab lists both settings.
title: notifications: sounds and settings tab
